title: Color Converter
description: Convert a color between HEX, RGB, and HSL — paste any format and get all three instantly.

input.title: Input
input.label: Color value
input.hint: Format is detected automatically from HEX, RGB, or HSL syntax.
input.clearConfirmDescription: This will remove the current input and result. This can't be undone.

output.title: Result
output.invalidHexDescription: This isn't a valid HEX color. Use # followed by 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. #f00 or #ff0000.
output.invalidRgbDescription: This isn't a valid RGB color. Use rgb(r, g, b) with each channel between 0 and 255.
output.invalidHslDescription: This isn't a valid HSL color. Use hsl(h, s%, l%) with hue 0-360 and saturation/lightness 0-100%.
output.invalidFormatDescription: This doesn't look like a HEX, RGB, or HSL color.
